title_en: From Frankenstein's Monster to Intrepid Detective: See an Exclusive Preview of Prometheus Graft - The Slayings at Death's End
summary_en: What happens when Frankenstein's Monster becomes Europe's most preeminent detective? Find out in this exclusive preview of Prometheus Graft: The Slayings at Death's End.
body_en:
Mary Shelley's Frankenstein has inspired all sorts of great comics over the years, and a new Oni Press series might just take its place among them. IGN can exclusively reveal Prometheus Graft: The Slayings at Death's End, a new murder mystery that casts Frankenstein's Monster as an intrepid detective.
Check out the slideshow gallery below for an exclusive first look at Prometheus Graft: The Slayings at Death's End #1:
Prometheus Graft: The Slayings at Death's End is written by George Northy (Yuletide, EC’s Shiver SuspenStories) and illustrated by Caitlin Yarsky (Dead Teenagers, Black Hammer). The first issue features cover art by Yarsky, Eric Powell, Gabriel Rodriguez, and Patricia Martin.
Here's the official summary for the new series:
"I’ve always adored an Agatha Christie-style whodunnit and wanted to create a classic detective tale with a supernatural twist," said Northy in a statement. "But who to cast as the Hercule Poirot, Sherlock Holmes or Benoit Blanc of this monster mash-up mystery? Then it came to me: The Creature in Mary Shelley’s iconic FRANKENSTEIN was brilliant, tortured and a ‘living puzzle’ himself. What if he set out to try to solve the mystery of what he really is—and who exactly makes up his disparate, grafted-together pieces—and, along the way, discovered a talent for solving all manner of occult mysteries? That became our hero detective, Prometheus Graft. In his debut mystery, Graft is invited to Death’s End Castle to observe a peace treaty renewal between clans of vampyrs, witches and werewolves—but instead must solve a series of brutal slayings to avert all-out paranormal war."
Prometheus Graft: The Slayings at Death's End #1 will be released on December 9. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .
For more, check out our exclusive preview of Image Comics' Decidium Returned and get the full scoop on the dramatic events of The Amazing Spider-Man #1000 .
